title: Cap. V Obj. 6: without foresight faith Christ is shut out of the election decree
pass_a_gloss: Objection 6. If election is not from foresight faith, then Christ is shut out from the decree of election, and men are first predestinated that they may be saved, before Christ that he may save them; for those who do not yet believe are still outside Christ: But Christ has been predestinated Savior of the faithful only, and of those joined to himself by faith: Therefore predestination is from foresight faith, or Christ (which is impious) will be shut out from the decree of election.
pass_b_english: Obj. 6. If election is not from foresight faith, then Christ is shut out of the election decree, and men are predestinated to be saved before Christ is predestinated to save them — for those who do not yet believe are still outside Christ. But Christ was predestinated Savior only of the faithful, joined to him by faith. Therefore predestination is from foresight faith, or Christ (which is impious) is shut out of the election decree.
source_text: Obj. 6. Si electio non sit ex fide praevisa, tum Christus excluditur a decreto electionis, et homines sunt prius praedestinati ut serventur, quam Christus ut eos servet; nam qui nondum credunt, sunt adhuc extra Christum: Christus autem praedestinatus est Salvator fidelium solummodo, et sibi per fidem conjunctorum: Ergo praedestinatio est ex fide praevisa, aut Christus (quod nefas est) a decreto electionis excludetur.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. V Obj. 6 section 421. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap5_obj6_densify. Honest partial.
